root.name: ブッキング・ホールディングス

companies.name: グーグル(アルファベット)

relations.text: 利用者の流入の多くを検索エンジンなどの第三者プラットフォーム経由で得ている
relations.text_en: Much of its consumer traffic comes via third-party platforms such as Google

source.label: Booking Holdings 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: A significant portion of consumer traffic to our services is derived from third-party platforms, including Google and other search engines, mobile operating systems, app marketplaces, mapping services, and other digital distribution channels

relations.text: Googleは検索や地図、Geminiに旅行商品を組み込んでいる
relations.text_en: Google has integrated travel products into its maps and Gemini offering

source.label: Booking Holdings 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: For example, Google links travel search to its dominant search engine and has integrated travel products into Google Maps and its Gemini generative AI ("Gen AI") offering

companies.name: エアビーアンドビー
companies.sub: 民泊プラットフォーム

relations.text: 宿泊事業と直接競合する会社の例に挙げられている
relations.text_en: Cited as a company that competes directly with its accommodations businesses

source.label: Booking Holdings 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: The market for accommodations covers a wide range of property types including alternative accommodations and companies like Airbnb and Vrbo (owned by Expedia) compete directly with our accommodations businesses

relations.text: 傘下のVrboが宿泊事業と直接競合している
relations.text_en: Its Vrbo unit competes directly with its accommodations businesses

source.label: Booking Holdings 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: The market for accommodations covers a wide range of property types including alternative accommodations and companies like Airbnb and Vrbo (owned by Expedia) compete directly with our accommodations businesses

relations.text: 非上場企業への株式投資にヤノルジャへの出資が含まれる
relations.text_en: Its equity investments in private entities include its investment in Yanolja

source.label: Booking Holdings 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: The Company's investments in equity securities of private entities at December 31, 2025 and 2024, includes its investment in Yanolja Co., Ltd. ("Yanolja")

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
